project.name: 毕加索风格海报
project.styleDefinitionBrief: 毕加索立体主义: 大胆色块拼接、几何碎片构图、蓝粉对比色、零圆角硬朗边角、原始张力排版、 Ochre 画布底色
project.designRead: poster / art-appreciation / bold cubist energy / medium-low density / avoid soft gradients, rounded corners, minimalism, pastel watercolor

colorSystem.primaryColorRole: picasso blue #2E5BA0 with rose #C46878 and ochre #C4953A as bold accents
colorSystem.brandHuePolicy: bold multi-hue palette: blue, rose, ochre, terra, sage — no single secondary accent

styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: zero radius — all sharp corners, geometric fragments, angular shapes
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: Playfair Display for dramatic titles, bold/heavy weights, tight leading, negative tracking
styleContinuityAnchors.spacingSystem: asymmetric collage layout, overlapping elements, dynamic white space
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: geometric blocks, color fields, angular dividers, collage layering
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: flat color blocks, no shadows on static, hard edges
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: cubist portraits, abstract guitar forms, bold shapes

sharedProjectShellContract.primaryColorSystem: picasso blue #2E5BA0 primary with rose/ochre bold accents
sharedProjectShellContract.typographySystem: Playfair Display dramatic titles, bold weights, tight leading, Noto Sans SC body

designSource.designDecisionSummary: 毕加索立体主义: 零圆角硬朗几何、蓝粉赭对比色块、拼贴式不对称构图、画布底色

pages.title: 毕加索风格海报
pages.businessScenario: 毕加索立体主义艺术风格宣传海报
pages.visualNorthStar: 立体主义碎片: 零圆角几何色块、蓝粉赭对比色、拼贴式不对称构图、粗体戏剧性排版
pages.compositionPattern: cubist-collage: overlapping geometric color blocks, asymmetric fragmented layout, bold angular dividers, hard-edge color fields
